tables.title: Daily activities and battlegrounds
rows:
Time: 13:00, 14:30, 18:30 (30 mins each)
Description:
Prepare for the war. Deliver vital supplies to Logistics Officers across the realm. A deposit is required to handle these goods.
How to play:
Accept the quest from the NPC and escort the goods to the destination.
Rewards:
Massive Gold based on delivery grade.

Time: 13:00, 14:30, 18:30 (30 mins each)
Description:
Ensure safe passage for your allies. Protect teammates on delivery missions to secure our victory.
How to play:
Prevent teammates from being killed while they transport goods.
Rewards:
Massive Gold.

Time: 13:00, 14:30, 18:30 (30 mins each)
Description:
A rogue's way to profit. Seize what others carry for your own gain.
How to play:
Defeat players on delivery missions to steal their cargo.
Rewards:
Massive Gold.

Description:
The divine light empowers all it touches, but its radiance is physically taxing. Do not push beyond your limits.
How to play:
While inside, you gain continuous EXP but take constant damage. Unity and healing are the keys to survival.
Rewards:
30% EXP based on your level.

Description:
The Undead presence has stirred evil creatures across Vidalia. Purge them from our land!
How to play:
Accept the quest, slay nearby monsters to find summoning items, and lure out the demonic targets. Defeat them and return for your reward.
Rewards:
80 Honor, 1 Refining Pill per member, and 20% EXP based on level.

Description:
A trial of blood and fire. True strength is forged only in the heat of battle!
How to play:
Speak with the King to enter. You have 30 seconds to prepare for 10 waves of relentless enemies. Slay them all to succeed.
Rewards:
Massive EXP based on waves cleared and character level.

Time: 14:00, 21:00 (30 mins)
Description:
This ancient site holds a legendary artifact. To hold it is to hold the power of a god. Will you be the next to ascend?
Victory: Hold the Fragarach at the center of the map when the timer ends.
Rewards:
While holding the artifact: 10 Honor every 15s, 1 Bronze Medal every 30s. Final winner receives: Fragarach for 1 day and 1 Gold Medal.
Restrictions:
No Mounts or Pets. Wing and Gem stats are disabled.

Time: 15:00, 19:00 (1 hour each)
Description:
Fate has chosen your side. Whether God or Demon, your path is paved in the blood of your rivals.
Victory: Destroy the enemy Life Crystal.
Rewards:
Claim from Managers after the battle. Min 5 Pts: 80 Honor, 10 Bronze Medals, 10% EXP.
Bonus: Honor for kills, 2% EXP for destroying towers. High scorers earn Silver/Gold Medals. Winners get +10 Bronze Medals.
Restrictions:
Combat Balance active. No Mounts or Pets.

Description:
The city outskirts are overrun. Slay the beasts to protect our people!
Rewards:
2% EXP based on level.
Bonus: Chance for a Morph Crystal on your 5th and 10th completion of the day.

Description:
As a citizen of Vidalia, it is your duty to help those in need. Good deeds never go unrewarded!
Rewards:
1 Coupon and EXP based on level.

Description:
New to Starglade? Take a walk around the city—you might find some unexpected surprises!
Rewards:
1 Coupon and EXP based on level.

Time: 10:00, 19:30
Description:
Pets have escaped from Beast Island! Hunt them down before they cause more trouble!
Rewards:
Random Phantom Feathers or Mount Token. EXP: 1% based on level.

Description:
Tend to these exotic lifeforms with care and patience.
How to Play:
Claim seeds from the NPC and nurture them. Greater yields lead to better rewards.
Rewards:
Earn EXP and massive Gold based on your level.

Description:
Tend to these exotic lifeforms with care and patience.
How to Play:
Claim seeds from the NPC and nurture them. Greater yields lead to better rewards.
Rewards:
Earn EXP and massive Gold based on your level.
Guild Daily Quests auto-refresh once daily at 10:00am.
Rewards obtained from the Holy Beast BOSS event can be used for Holy Beast Raising, which grants special rewards.
Challenge the Holy Beast BOSS to obtain Holy Beast Raising materials. Ranking on the damage leaderboard also grants special rewards.

tables.title: Previously released timed events — rotating availability
rows:
During the event, players who log in between 20:00-21:00 each day can go to the [Event Ambassador] to claim a Limited-Time Gift Pack *1. Each player can claim it only once per day.
The Limited-Time Gift Pack contains:
Event Coins *2
Pet Essence *5
2x EXP [Bound] *1
2x Pet-EXP [Bound] *1

At 10:00, 15:00, and 20:00 daily, 5 Bosses and 10 Imps will spawn in Starglade Ch. 1. Defeat them for grand rewards.
Loot ownership is determined by the last hit.

Join the Crypt at 12:00 daily. Reach the top floor to receive 4 random Lucky Cards (A, B, C, D). Trade with others to collect a full set and exchange it at the Quartermaster for a Lucky Pack. Limit: 1 per day.
Slay Lvl 20+ monsters for a chance to find Demon Souls. Collect 200 to exchange for a Soul Pack at the Quartermaster. Limit: 1 per day.
Recharge to specific tiers during the event to claim bonus rewards. Rewards include Fortune Crystals. Spend them in the Recharge Wheel to draw Crystals.
Spend Crystals during the event to reach milestones and claim bonus rewards.

During the event, reaching specific top-up tiers with Magic Crystal purchases grants corresponding rebate rewards. Players who top up over $100 during the event will be ranked; the top 10 will receive generous rewards. Ranking rewards will be distributed via mail after the event ends.

Event: Daily 20:00-21:00. A Void Rift will open above Starglade. Every 15 mins, a wave of Void Invaders (4 Void Bosses) will attack. Defend the city center for rewards. If 12+ Bosses are defeated server-wide, all can claim a Void Pack from the Event Master.
Spend 3 Gold for a Common Oracle Ticket or 5 Gold for a Greater Oracle Ticket. Scratch for 1~5 Event Coins. Limit: 1 of each daily.
Get items at 40% off in the Discount Shop during the event! Huge savings. Don't miss out!
Complete Deliveries to earn 1 Event Coin and a 50% chance for a Lucky Pack!

During the event, mineral veins will erupt in Starglade Line 1 daily from 12:00-13:00 and 19:00-20:00. Multiple surface veins will appear in the city. Players can go to collect them and randomly obtain item rewards!
Donate 1 Gold at the Quartermaster for 20 Roses and a chance at an Event Coin. Reach server milestones for global rewards! Max 10 daily donations.
Slay Lvl 15+ field monsters during the event. Reach 7,000, 14,000, 21,000, 35,000, and 50,000 kills to claim rewards!
Top up in the Shop during the event to receive a 100% Crystal rebate! Don't miss this limited opportunity!
During the event, purchase the Limited-Time First Top-up for 4.99 to receive generous item rewards. Purchase continuously for a certain number of days to unlock surprise grand prizes!
Every 1 cent recharged equals 3 points. Spend points in the shop for premium items. Points reset after the event.
During the event, spend 1 Crystal = 3 Points. Earned Points can be used to buy various in-game items in the Points Mall. After the event ends, unused Points will be cleared.

During the event, daily from 13:00-14:00 and 20:00-21:00, Void Rifts will appear over Cragstone, Himeng Valley, Glimmering Plains, Kaspaya Beach, and Kaymo Mountain, spawning waves of Pumpkins. Defeat them for generous item rewards!
Slay Lvl 20+ monsters to find Ruins Scraps 1, 2, and 3. Collect them to synthesize a Ruins Map at the Starglade Quartermaster and unearth grand rewards!
Earn special daily rewards from the Quartermaster after challenging the Ladder. Limit: 1x claim per tier.
Slay Lvl 25+ Dungeon Bosses to earn milestone rewards!
Purchase the Demon's Gift for Crystals and a Overlord Chest. Open the chest for a chance at rare items!

Daily 14:00–16:00
Claim 3 treasure maps from the Quartermaster. Use them to find hidden locations and unearth grand rewards!
Log in daily between 12:00–13:00 to claim a Lunchbox from the Event Master for instant rewards.
On October 31st (19:00 - 22:00), logged-in players can claim a Halloween Gift Pack from the Halloween Master. Limit one per player.
